system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Melee Weapons

You are trained to repel attackers and guard nearby allies.

Once per turn, you may use do one of the following:

  • When an enemy comes within melee range of you, may immediately make a melee attack against them as a Free Action. If it hits, the enemy's movement stops immediately. They may use an Action to move again.

  • When an enemy within melee range attacks a target other than you, you can immediately make a melee attack against the attacking creature as a Free Action.
